expression_restriction.value: Natural expression required — no smile, laugh, or frown; mouth must be closed; eyes open

ears_visibility.value: Ears must be fully visible (hair kept off the face)

face_visibility.value: Photo must be centered and facing straight forward; forehead must be fully visible (hair off the face)

headwear_policy.value: Only religious hats or scarves are allowed

expression.en: A natural expression is required — no smile, laugh, or frown; mouth closed, eyes open.
expression.ko: 자연스러운 무표정 필수 — 미소·웃음·찡그림 금지. 입은 다물고 눈은 뜬 상태.
expression.ja: 自然な表情が必須 — 微笑み・笑い・しかめ面は不可。口は閉じ、目は開けた状態。

glasses.ja: 度付き眼鏡(視力矯正用)のみ許可。

ears_visibility.en: Ears must be fully visible; hair must be kept off the face.
ears_visibility.ko: 귀가 완전히 드러나야 함. 머리카락이 얼굴을 가리지 않도록 해야 함.
ears_visibility.ja: 耳が完全に見えている必要あり。髪の毛で顔を覆わないこと。

face_visibility.en: The photo must be centered, facing straight forward, with the forehead fully visible.
face_visibility.ko: 사진은 정중앙에 정면을 응시한 상태여야 하며, 이마가 완전히 드러나야 함.
face_visibility.ja: 写真は中央に配置し、正面をまっすぐ向いた状態で、額が完全に見えている必要あり。

headwear.en: Only religious hats or scarves are permitted.
headwear.ja: 宗教的な帽子やスカーフのみ着用可。

source_status_note.note: us.embassyeritrea.org is the official website of the Eritrean Embassy to the United States — Eritrea does not appear to operate a unified central government web portal with a dedicated passport-photo requirements page, so the embassy's own consular page is used as the official source, consistent with this being a small-country case where official-source availability is inherently thin.

clothing_restriction.note: A 'wear ordinary clothes, no uniforms, dark clothing recommended for white-background contrast' claim appeared in a secondary web search, but could not be cleanly attributed to us.embassyeritrea.org itself (the direct WebFetch of that exact page did not surface any clothing-specific statement) — left unverified rather than asserted.
